platform_reference.direct_developer_pages: web tool non-retryable unavailable; no platform/security setting changed
platform_reference.clock_correction: Official Performance interface does not declare now; do not assume wx.getPerformance().now. Use an independent local logical deadline clock with a timer floor, explicitly separate from server time.
platform_reference.runtime_minimum: TCP2.18.0; methods and BigInt must actually exist; version labels alone do not prove runtime support

implementation.session_driver: Reuse web/launcher-session.mjs with an explicit optional createAbortController port; native browser default preserved.
implementation.adapter: adapters/wechat entry composes existing current session, bounded TCP, CSPRNG and local deadline clock; no copied protocol state machine
implementation.clock: Date delta is clamped monotonically; timer callback advances to its scheduled elapsed floor so a wall-clock rollback cannot keep rearming the same total deadline. Timer cancellation suppresses late callbacks. Host suspension/timer delays still require lifecycle cancellation and real-platform validation.
implementation.signals: Private branded controller internal to adapter; no DOM/global polyfill; caller cancels with public session.cancel().
implementation.endpoints: Explicit1..10 configured endpoints; canonical DNS or LAN IPv4 subset; no localhost/public raw IP; documented forbidden ports rejected. Native domain/quota rules remain enforced by platform.
implementation.buffers: Incoming total and queued bytes at most4MiB, chunks64KiB; owned outbound buffers retained until close under4MiB budget because native write is void and consumption timing is not proved.
implementation.completion: Native write acceptance only. No peer-delivery/startup/account authentication claim; snapshots remain authentication:unverified.
implementation.build: Pinned local esbuild produces CommonJS entry in privatebuild; no Node/DOM/network fallback or AppID/credentials embedded.
implementation.scope: Transport/session thin adapter connected to existing flow. Full mini-program screens, HTTP/catalog/resource adapters and real runtime/official acceptance remain incomplete.
